messages:
Renee K.: small UX review: propose grouping left nav by user goals (Build / Ship / Observe / Admin) instead of product names. also add a tiny "Shortcuts" pill strip at top for jump-to links.
Tom W.: agreed on grouping. how do breadcrumbs work with that? i assume they reflect the URL so back/forward stays sane.
Isha V.: yes breadcrumb = path segments. accessibility: ensure crumb links have aria-current and shortcuts are in the tab order. Skip link to shortcuts would help keyboard users.
Renee K.: routing note: prefer pathname-first routes with a hash fallback for legacy links. we should maintain a small alias map for old URLs. Tom, can you mock the collapsed group behavior?
Tom W.: will do. collapse state persisted per-user (localStorage) and animation minimal.
Isha V.: copy: use "Metrics & Traces" in tooltip, but short label in nav as "Observe". keeps things concise.
build-bot: Created ticket REDINF-4499: "Intent-based nav + Shortcuts strip + path/hash routing" assigned to @Tom W., @Isha V. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/REDINF-4499
Renee K.: thanks all. i'll add figma link and we can merge when a11y checklist is green.
_meta: Compact Slack thread about left-nav IA, shortcuts strip, breadcrumbs, pathname-first routing with hash fallback, and a11y checklist.
